item.question: What is the purpose of using a variable direction forgetting recursive-least-square algorithm in power networks?
item.answer: The variable direction forgetting recursive-least-square (VDF-RLS) algorithm is used in power networks to improve the estimation of inverter output impedance. It adapts effectively to changes and maintains stable estimation under no-excitation conditions, outperforming other algorithms like RLS without forgetting and Kalman filter-based methods.
